summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by The Charles Schwab Corporation for a public offering of depositary shares representing a 1/100th interest in shares of its Series L Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The filing describes the terms of the new issuance, including dividend structure, redemption provisions, and voting rights. There are no terms related to an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine capital markets transaction.
